title: Every work item says why it helps users and why it is the simplest thing that works
description: Against a real control plane and isolated Postgres, a create without why or simplest is refused naming the missing field; the dashboard create box files both, and the item page and Work list row lead with them; a requirements revision changes what is shown; an item created before the change opens with neither. Every built-in creator supplies both, and the master prompt, master guide, create help and worker prompt ask for them first.

steps.name: create refusal, revision, creators and prompts
file through the create box and read both sentences on the page and in the Work list
